description:
Dissolve the world countries layer into continent regions.

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the 'ne_110m_admin_0_countries' shapefile from /home/ga/GIS_Data/natural_earth/.
3. Open the Dissolve tool (Vector > Geoprocessing Tools > Dissolve).
4. Select 'ne_110m_admin_0_countries' as the Input layer.
5. Click the '...' button next to 'Dissolve field(s)' and check the 'CONTINENT' field. Click OK to return to the dialog.
6. Under 'Dissolved', choose 'Save to File...' and save as GeoJSON to /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/continents_dissolved.geojson.
7. Click Run.
